# 4 bedroom terraced house for sale

> The Property A well-proportioned four-bedroom town house situated on a popular residential development on the northern outskirts of Lincoln, offering generous living space together with a private rear garden, garage and driveway parking. The ground floor has an entrance hall with access to a downstairs WC, a separate kitchen/breakfast room and a particularly spacious living/dining room.

## Fakta
- Typ: terraced house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Plocha: 108 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: Bobbin Lane, Lincoln
- Cena: £230,000
